278382573.description: This lot includes 9 natural mineral specimens primarily composed of selenite, a crystalline form of gypsum. The pieces range in translucency from translucent to transparent and exhibit a pearly luster. Most specimens are colorless or white, with one showing a light tan hue. The crystals display characteristic striated and bladed formations and are in raw, unpolished condition with some natural edge chipping. These selenite specimens are suitable for mineral collectors, metaphysical applications, or educational purposes.

Natural Mineral Specimens
13 Pound Geode and Crystal Collection
Amethyst, Agate, Quartz, and Tumbled Stones
13 lbs (Total Weight)
Natural Geological Specimens
This diverse geological collection features approximately 13 pounds of natural mineral specimens. The lot includes high-quality amethyst clusters, polished banded agate slices, and hollow quartz geodes with sparkling crystalline interiors. Also present are various tumbled and raw stones such as tiger's eye, desert rose selenite, and rose quartz, representing a wide spectrum of geological formations and mineral types suitable for display, collection, or educational study.
Features large amethyst druze specimens and polished banded agate slices
Includes a diverse variety of tumbled stones and raw mineral samples
Largest specimens range from approximately 3 to 6 inches in size
Weighs 13 lbs total for a substantial starting collection or bulk lot
Condition:
Very good natural condition. Specimens exhibit original rocky matrix and natural inclusions as expected with raw minerals. Polished pieces show smooth finishes, while geodes remain hollow with intact crystal structures. Minor age-appropriate wear to labels and natural geological fissures are present throughout the lot.
